{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for only email and paid_search channels
channel_filter = df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])
df_filtered = df[channel_filter]

# Compute conversion rate for email
df_email = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'email']
conversion_rate_email = df_email['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rate for paid_search
df_paid_search = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'paid_search']
conversion_rate_paid_search = df_paid_search['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Print all values with 4 decimal places to match the precision of the final answer
print(f'{conversion_rate_email:.4f}')
print(f'{conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}')
print(f'{difference:.4f}')"}
